title: The Telangana Land Revenue (Enhancement) Act, 1967.
full_text: The Telangana Land Revenue (Enhancement) Act, 1967. Rules Regulations Notifications Orders Circulars Ordinance Statutes SectionsScheduleAnnexureAppendixFormsActdetails Act ID: 19678 Act Number: 8 Enactment Date: 1967-10-04 Act Year: 1967 Short Title: The Telangana Land Revenue (Enhancement) Act, 1967. Long Title: An Act to declare the Government s right to levy and to collect, and to have levied and collected, land revenue, and to provide, for the levy of additional land revenue, and for the levy of land revenue on certain lands in the State of Telangana and for the revision of the cess leviable in respect of all lands and for matters connected therewith.
